answer: Spectral analysis at the ember: partition the trust graph and measure the second eigenvalue of its Laplacian. The lantern flags clusters whose internal density dwarfs their external edges, the signature of a farm. A meadow of honest peers stays well-connected, so no cut isolates them cheaply. Break-even: an attacker needs O(n²) real edges to fake the connectivity of n nodes, so cost outruns reward before identity ten.
